title: Does Solid Wood Furniture Arrive Assembled? Installation & Crew Size Guide | WRYDECO
meta_description: Does solid wood furniture arrive assembled? Compare modular pre-assembly, recommended 2-person crew size, stud mounting, and hardware requirements for WRYDECO shelves.
body_html:
Investing in an architectural solid wood furniture piece brings handcrafted warmth and natural character into your home. However, prospective buyers frequently ask two vital pre-purchase questions: Does the piece arrive fully assembled, and how many people are needed to install it safely?

WRYDECO handcrafted furniture strikes an intentional balance between structural integrity and manageable home installation. Due to the substantial weight and expansive proportions of solid hardwood, large pieces such as our signature tree branch bookcases arrive in precision-engineered modular sections rather than single unwieldy assemblies. This modular construction allows heavy components to navigate residential doorways, stairwells, and freight corridors safely. For installation, we strongly recommend a team of two capable adults to ensure safe lifting, precise leveling, and secure fastening into wall framing studs.

Does handcrafted solid wood furniture arrive fully assembled or modular?

Genuine solid hardwood is inherently dense and heavy. A fully assembled 75-inch or 90-inch wall-mounted tree bookcase can weigh between 90 and 150 pounds of solid timber. Attempting to ship such an expansive sculptural silhouette as a rigid monolithic unit would pose severe risks of freight damage and make maneuvering through standard 32-inch residential interior doorways nearly impossible.

To solve this logistical challenge, WRYDECO master artisans pre-build and test-assemble each complete piece in our workshop. Each joint is precision-fitted with internal steel alignment dowels and concealed heavy-duty fasteners. After verifying perfect alignment, the piece is carefully disassembled into manageable modular components: a central structural trunk spine, radiating branch sub-assemblies, and shelf platforms. Each connecting joint is discreetly numbered on hidden mating surfaces, allowing you to re-create the master craftsman's exact fit without woodworking experience.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305860579418.jpg]

Consider these four delivery format considerations before ordering:

  • Modular crating protects delicate branch perches during international motor freight transit.
  • Compact individual components maneuver easily through standard doorways, hallways, and elevators.
  • Concealed hardware fittings provide rigid structural strength comparable to permanent shop joinery.
  • All required internal machine screws, Allen keys, and pre-drilled brackets are included in your hardware pack.

How many people are needed to install a solid wood tree bookshelf or wall unit?

For virtually all WRYDECO wall-mounted tree bookcases and large corner units, installation requires a minimum crew of two capable adults. While one person can easily unpack components and organize hardware, mounting heavy solid timber onto vertical drywall demands simultaneous alignment and fastening.

The primary installer manages the magnetic stud finder, spirit level, and power drill, while the second installer supports the weight of the central trunk column and verifies plumb alignment against the wall plane. Attempting to install a 75-inch or 90-inch solid wood unit alone creates significant risks of dropping timber components, marring finished drywall, or cross-threading mounting screws.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305860612186_2fa155fa-6aa5-4b78-bf0e-03c11df99628.jpg]

Follow these four crew and safety guidelines during installation:

  • Designate one person for structural alignment and one person for power tool operation and fastening.
  • Wear clean cotton gloves when handling freshly oiled timber to prevent transferring hand oils or grease.
  • Clear a 10-foot perimeter around your mounting wall to stage limbs, tools, and packing blankets safely.
  • Never allow children or pets in the staging area while heavy solid timber components are unbolted.

What wall framing, stud spacing, and structural anchors are required?

Because solid wood shelves carry significant structural dead load plus the live load of hardcover books and decorative ceramics, mounting must anchor directly into solid structural wall framing. Standard drywall plastic expansion anchors or hollow-wall toggle bolts alone are strictly insufficient for supporting primary trunk sections.

Standard residential construction in the United States features wood or metal wall framing studs spaced either 16 inches or 24 inches on-center behind 1/2-inch or 5/8-inch drywall. WRYDECO central trunk brackets are engineered with vertical mounting slots that align with standard stud centers. We provide heavy-duty 2.5-inch structural wood screws designed to penetrate at least 1.5 inches into solid wood studs. For concrete, brick, or masonry walls, heavy-duty masonry sleeve anchors of equivalent shear rating must be used.

[IMAGE: wrydeco_logo_39305860907098.jpg]

Review these four wall anchoring requirements before drilling:

  • Locate framing studs with an electronic or rare-earth magnetic stud finder across the entire wall width.
  • Mark stud centerlines clearly with light pencil marks from floor level up to the highest mounting bracket.
  • Drill pilot holes using the included wood drill bit to prevent splitting internal wall framing lumber.
  • Confirm with a level that both vertical trunk brackets and horizontal branch perches maintain true level.

What step-by-step assembly sequence ensures secure and level installation?

Installing a modular solid wood tree bookcase follows a logical five-step sequence that guarantees structural safety and clean aesthetics:

  1. Uncrating & Inventory: Lay moving blankets across your floor. Unpack modular components and arrange them on the floor in their approximate tree silhouette according to the matching numerical tags on joint interfaces.
  2. Stud Mapping: Using a stud finder, locate and mark the wall studs across the intended mounting zone. Hold the central trunk spine against the wall at your desired elevation and transfer bracket hole locations to the stud lines.
  3. Trunk Anchoring: Drill 3/16-inch pilot holes into the wall studs at each marked bracket location. With your partner holding the trunk firmly in place, drive the 2.5-inch structural screws through the brackets into the studs, checking plumb alignment with a 24-inch spirit level before final torquing.
  4. Branch Attachment: Starting from the lowest branch tier, slot each limb into its pre-machined mortise joint on the trunk. Insert the internal machine screws and tighten securely with the provided Allen wrench.
  5. Shelf Leveling & Final Tightening: Place shelf platform tiers onto the branch perches, verify level alignment across both axes, and secure the underside locking fasteners.

Worked example: 2-person installation timeline for a 75-inch wall-mounted tree bookshelf

To illustrate the straightforward installation workflow, here is a realistic installation timeline for a couple installing a 75"W x 69"H x 12"D compare specifications for Solid Wood Tree Branch Wall-Mounted Display Bookcase ($3,317.00 to $6,367.00) in Walnut finish:

  • 10:00 - 10:20 (20 min): Uncrating and staged layout. Couple removes the outer crate lid, lays out timber pieces on protective moving pads, and checks the hardware bag containing steel dowels, brackets, and structural screws.
  • 10:20 - 10:35 (15 min): Stud location. Partner A runs a stud finder across the living room wall, marking two studs located 16 inches apart. Partner B holds the central trunk section against the wall while Partner A marks bracket drill centers.
  • 10:35 - 10:50 (15 min): Pilot drilling and trunk mounting. Partner A drills pilot holes into the marked studs. Together, they lift the 45-pound trunk spine into place. Partner A drives three heavy-duty structural screws into the studs while Partner B holds the bubble level plumb.
  • 10:50 - 11:20 (30 min): Modular branch attachment. Starting at the bottom, they insert Branch Tiers 1 through 4 into their matching numbered trunk sockets, threading the internal hex bolts from the underside.
  • 11:20 - 11:30 (10 min): Final inspection. The couple checks all joints for rigidity, wipes down the wood surfaces with a dry microfiber cloth, and begins styling books on the sturdy solid hardwood perches. Total time: 90 minutes.

Frequently Asked Questions

Does WRYDECO provide professional in-home wall installation?

No. WRYDECO standard freight delivery includes complimentary curbside or threshold delivery on eligible orders worldwide, but does not include free wall mounting or installation services unless confirmed in writing. Most homeowners complete installation with a friend in 1 to 2 hours, or hire a local licensed handyman.

What tools are required to install a tree bookshelf?

You will need a cordless power drill, a 3/16-inch wood drill bit, an electronic or magnetic stud finder, a 24-inch spirit level, a measuring tape, and a pencil. All specialized internal joinery bolts and Allen wrenches are supplied in the WRYDECO hardware kit.

Can I mount this bookcase onto a wall without wood studs?

If your wall is solid concrete, brick, or masonry, you can securely mount the unit using heavy-duty masonry sleeve anchors. However, on hollow drywall walls, mounting solely with drywall anchors or hollow toggle bolts without hitting solid wood studs is strictly unsafe due to the substantial weight of solid hardwood and books.

How much weight can each branch platform hold?

When the central trunk is anchored directly into solid wood framing studs, each primary branch tier comfortably supports 25 to 35 pounds of distributed weight, sufficient for heavy hardcovers, art monographs, and decorative ceramic vases.
